statement: The release workflow performs its heavy proof and artifact construction on the controlled runner, then publishes the same verified bytes on a GitHub-hosted runner supported by npm trusted publishing; one commit-and-run-bound handoff owner rejects substituted identities, files and digests before any publication, restores canonical executable modes, and keeps public checksums usable beside the published assets.

constraints.statement: Define the artifact set, identity, hashes and canonical modes once in a handoff owner. Consumers validate, not reconstruct, this contract.

Use the producer artifact ID in the same workflow run and a separately bound manifest digest. Never repack npm, rebuild images or replace artifacts after verification. Publisher-only reruns may differ in run attempt but not run, tag or commit.

Reject unexpected/missing/non-regular files, digest/size/identity mismatch and image provenance mismatch before npm or Docker credentials are used. Use a fresh temporary download directory and no cross-run download override.

Retain OIDC and provenance, existing npm authorization/registry integrity owner, release serialization, current-tag/main checks, Docker latest fencing and forward-only partial-channel repair. No new credentials or gate weakening.

Own release workflow producer/publisher handoff, its source and tests, release documentation and generated metadata. The separate Docker/proof-dispatch Quest remains independently scoped and will be integrated before the final publish.
